These top 30 results are the most common labs across the entire OMOP database — not lupus-specific. To answer the question properly, I need to compare testing frequency in lupus patients vs general population to find clinically enriched associations (e.g. ANA, anti-dsDNA, complement levels), then look up what each test measures biochemically.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Lupus-enriched measurements: compare frequency among lupus patients vs general population
SELECT 
  mo.measurement_concept_id,
  c.concept_name,
  c.vocabulary_id,
  COUNT(*) as lupus_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN co2.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as lupus_patients
FROM omop.measurement mo
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON mo.person_id = co.person_id AND mo.visit_occurrence_id = co.visit_occurrence_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON mo.measurement_concept_id = c.concept_id
LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co2 ON mo.person_id = co2.person_id AND co2.condition_concept_id IN (257628, 255891)
WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN (257628, 255891)
GROUP BY mo.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, c.vocabulary_id
ORDER BY lupus_count DESC
LIMIT 40
